teachingClaim.scope: One learned initiating action, Cap Throw, reused with new targets and outcomes; capture then gives target-specific abilities.

supports: A cap throw can attack foes, trigger switches and smash blocks.
Throwing Cappy at eligible enemies/objects Captures them and gives their abilities.
Official page includes Chain Chomp and T-Rex capture examples.
primaryEvidence.doesNotProve: A quantitative learning-speed benefit or all actions using one button.

primaryEvidence.supports: Cappy controls certain objects/enemies; cap throws knock down objects/enemies. Use the accessible UK page as the direct verification source.

teachingClaim.editorialInference: Connecting familiar cap-throw initiation to new outcomes is an explanatory design interpretation grounded in the observed sequence, not a measured experiment or attributed designer quotation.
limits: Capture applies to eligible targets, not every enemy/object.
Newly captured forms have their own move/attack instructions.
The footage visibly contains tutorial prompts: never claim no tutorial or no explanations.
Do not claim every action in Odyssey uses one button.
Do not claim a measured coin balance increase, exact reward count or learning-speed multiplier from these images.

rightsRecords.observed: Archive 64 describes its no-commentary recordings as freely usable for entertainment or editing; credit is optional but appreciated. The prior source-specific record says monetized and nonmonetized use are permitted.
rightsRecords.creditPlacement: absolute bottom of complete KO/EN descriptions; no added on-screen source line
rightsRecords.notAssumed: Permission for a recording is distinct from rights in Nintendo game content.

rightsRecords.observed: Guidelines updated 2024-09-02 permit individual consumers to use released Nintendo game content with creative input/commentary and specified platform monetization, including YouTube Partner Program. They prohibit merely copying third-party content without required permission, imply no Nintendo sponsorship, and separate non-game-content assets from captured gameplay.
rightsRecords.application: Independent recorder permission plus original explanatory narration/annotation/editing; released retail gameplay. Do not extract Nintendo character assets into the Unity illustration.
